problem_class.label: convex
problem_class.details: Unconstrained convex minimization of f: ℝ^d → ℝ, with an attained global minimum and some minimizer xstar satisfying ‖x0 − xstar‖ ≤ R.

oracle.label: exact_gradient
oracle.details: One oracle returns ∇f(x) at any queried x ∈ ℝ^d. Every history and oracle seed must return the exact gradient; function values are not supplied. Algorithms may be randomized and have unrestricted query points and outputs.
oracle.evidence: LongTails/Setups/RadiusOnlyGeneralizedSmoothConvex.lean: spec.admissible, HasGradientAt clause; LongTails/Setups/GeneralizedSmoothConvexPolynomialDimension.lean: spec.Query, spec.Reply; LongTails/Template.lean: Algorithm, Setup.allowedAlgorithm, executeWithTrace.

distinctive_assumptions.label: generalized_smoothness
distinctive_assumptions.details: The gradient is differentiable everywhere and ‖D(∇f)(x)‖ ≤ L0 + L1‖∇f(x)‖ globally, with L0,L1 > 0. No global constant bound on the Hessian or gradient is assumed.
distinctive_assumptions.evidence: LongTails/Setups/RadiusOnlyGeneralizedSmoothConvex.lean: spec.admissible, Differentiable and fderiv clauses; LongTails/Setups/GeneralizedSmoothConvexPolynomialDimension.lean: spec.valid.

distinctive_assumptions.label: finite_dimensional
distinctive_assumptions.details: Euclidean space ℝ^d with d ≥ ⌈17592186044416(1 + L1R)^5⌉.

distinctive_assumptions.label: other
distinctive_assumptions.details: All parameters d,L0,L1,x0,R,ε are public. R > 0 bounds distance to a minimizer; no initial objective-gap bound is supplied. The parameter regime requires L1R ≥ 1048576.

accuracy.label: objective_gap
accuracy.details: Output any point X ∈ ℝ^d with integrable objective gap and E[f(X) − f(xstar)] ≤ ε for a global minimizer xstar. The accuracy regime is L0/L1² ≤ ε ≤ L0R²/16, with ε > 0.

accuracy.label: expected
accuracy.details: The objective-gap guarantee is in expectation over algorithm and oracle seeds; no almost-sure or high-probability accuracy requirement is imposed.

setup_category.label: non_standard
setup_category.reason: The setup combines convex generalized smoothness and radius-only initialization information with a prescribed large-L1R accuracy regime and an explicit polynomial dimension threshold.
